name: Sunday Night Rave!

date.source: The card's own date, billed in a Wayback-captured 5 Feb 2003 news post, "All the News!"

notes: Billed a singles match for Tempest's Coming Storm Championship — Totakoxe Salvador (C) vs. Shawn Stewart — the only match the surviving record bills for this card, with no result surviving; both men stand as billed appearances above. The site's own weekly-card cadence is not itself a receipt for any other match or any other week's show (#the-collected-edge).

name: Tuesday Night Rave!

date.source: The card's own date, billed in the academy's own 22 Jun 2003 news post, "This is Rumor Control, These are the Facts" (newsdata/2.news)

notes: The card as announced in advance — all seventeen named competitors stand as billed appearances above — six billed pairings/groupings, four of them a third-round tournament for "the soon to be renamed PWA Championship": Suicide vs. Morbid Angel (singles); CJ Styles vs. "Eccentric" Jonas Mathers vs. Colby Korver (three way singles); a battle royal among Jacob Green, Chris Locke, The Fan, Rob Davies, Kevin Dunne and Calvin Riley for a semi-final spot; Jack Murphy vs. Rey Campbell; The First vs. Mawayani; Matt Blitz vs. Gabe Ranae — the latter four billed as third-round tournament matches. No results page for this show survives, so no match here carries a winner. The same news post gives an in-card-grades eligibility list (Gabe Ranae) and a Zeus-stats eligibility list (Calvin Riley, "Eccentric" Jonas Mathers, The First, Gabe Ranae, Rey Campbell), recorded on those characters' own tenures, not here.
